violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. Observed the employee at the warewashing area changing gloves between handling soiled and clean dishes, but he did not wash his hands while doing so.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. The EHS discussed this with the PIC and the employee. CDI.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: several soup bowls were visibly soiled and not clean.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. The PIC moved the bowls to the warewashing area and had them cleaned and sanitized.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: There was a gap at the bottom of the back door large enough for pests to enter the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Seal the back door with a door sweep to prevent pests from entering. Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. When the door is properly sealed, there should be no outside light visible under the door from inside.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. The EHS discussed this with the PIC.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: cardboard MSG containers are being reused to stored star anise and other foods, which is not approved.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. Discontinue reusing cardboard and other manufacturer containers. Replace them with approved food-grade equipment that can be properly cleaned and sanitized. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: broken down cardboard boxes were being used to line shelving in the hallway. The cardboard is visibly soiled and needs to be removed.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. Discontinue reusing cardboard to line shelving. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. A hose is connected to a food prep sink with no backflow prevention.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. Install a vacuum breaker on the hose bib or cut the length of the hose. The PIC removed the hose during the inspection and will order and install a vacuum breaker.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was handling dirty dishes, and then handled clean dishes, but did not wash their hands in between. He only rinsed his hands with warm water in a prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. The EHS spoke to the manager about this, and the manager spoke to the food employee. CDI.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink after handling dirty dishes and before handling soiled dishes.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. The EHS spoke to the person in charge about this and the person in charge spoke to the food employee. CDI. PHO 75 (Inspection Date: 11/20/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. All food establishments must have a thermometer that can measure the temperature of food. Provide a thermometer within 10 days.

violations.title: Air/Water Thermometers Accuracy, Degrees C & F
violations.observation: The thermometer and the noodles only refrigerator was inaccurate. It was reading 50°F, but the unit was 40°F.
violations.corrective_action: Ambient air and water temperature measuring devices that are scaled in Celsius or dually scaled in Celsius and Fahrenheit shall be designed to be easily readable and accurate to a +/-1.5 degrees C in the intended range of use. Install a new thermometer in the unit within 10 days.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a bleach test kit within 10 days.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The inside of the refrigerator chest for storing noodles and sprouts was visibly soiled in a need of cleaning. There was also standing water in the bottom of it.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Please clean out this ice chest within 10 days.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed a hose attached to a faucet fixture. The hose extended below the flood rim level of the sink basin.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by providing an air gap as specified under 5-202.13. The person in charge removed the hose. CDI.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bin and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. Black buildup observed on the interior of the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: *raw beef observed in pot in back hallway not under refrigeration and not in-use at 47-61F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Foods that were observed at the incorrect temperature were taken and cooked or served immediately. PIC stated that they had not been out of temperature for more than 1 hour.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: Soups are being cooled at room temperature in the back hallway. During the inspection, the temperatures for the soup remained at around 75F.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. PIC was provided with cooling guidance posters and EHS discussed proper cooling techniques and logging temperatures to ensure that cooling is accomplished within the specified time requirements.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: PIC stated foods are being run under water to be thawed and then they are staged for use. Inspector observed raw beef in a large pot and PIC stated that the beef had completed thawing in the morning around 10AM and was about to be cooked. EHS observed the beef at 47-67F during the inspection- Thawing was not accomplished according to regulation.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS discussed proper temperature regulation during the thawing process.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor of the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: cardboard is being used to line the shelves and the soup cooling area.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Plastic dry storage containers and container lids are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The backflow prevention device at the spray-down hose next to the dishwashing machine is broken and needs to be repaired or replaced.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the Sealant around the sinks are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Areas of silicone/sealant that cannot be cleaned shall be replaced to maintain a tight seal against the wall and to prevent the growth of bacteria.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils above back 2 dr reach in drink cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. PIC removed open drink containers from storage above food and food prep surfaces.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw eye round steak stored above ready to eat fatty brisket in 2 dr upright at deli slicer station.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC placed eye round below all ready to eat items.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: raw beef brisket stored in ambient temperature water in preparation sink
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PIC placed beef brisket under refrigeration for proper thawing.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Unpackaged Food Preparation, No Contamination
violations.observation: Observed unpackaged food exposed to potential contamination during preparation. Observed cooked rice noodles dipped into ambient temperature water before service. Ambient water used for the preparation of noodles originated from mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: During preparation, unpackaged food, shall be protected from environmental contamination. PIC discarded rice noodles.
